description: This file contains shell functions for handling platform-specific upgrade operations in an embedded Linux system, including image verification, partition management, and device upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and layout of an upgrade image, comparing the partition table from the image to the existing device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the device upgrade by writing images to the disk, managing partitions, and copying data as needed.
